adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does a non-atomic read-then-write: `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })` and, if none, `prisma.credential.create(...)`. With concurrent webhook deliveries for the same `(userId, appSlug)`, both requests can observe “no row” and both execute the create branch, producing duplicate credential rows if the DB does not enforce a unique constraint. The code comment (“Can't use prisma upsert as we don't know the id”) further indicates there is no atomic uniqueness-based upsert being used here.
